label: Teufelsberg field station, main listening tower (radomes), Berlin
note: six variations IR-01 to IR-06 (the receiver key); what differs (dome, position, processing) is not stated; mastered by Balance Mastering; no decay time is stated, and RIRDB measures rt_mid 9.5-11.7 s on IR-01 to IR-05, with the high bands near the air-absorption limit, as a hard radome gives; IR-06 is cut at 2.15 s, so its rt_mid of about 4.1 s comes from T20 and is too short; the files end in a fade, so no noise floor is seen, and the 8 kHz T30 (15-29 s on 4 IRs) is a fit to the noise floor, not a decay time
